title: elaborating-user-stories stage input (POST-adapter payload at stage ba-research)
description: The real payload the engine assembles for the elaboration stage: workflow input picks, the intake normalized_request, and the APPROVED breakdown pack nested under `breakdown` with its ref-chain already hydrated (epics, stories, rules, domain, flows dereferenced inline). ENFORCED fail-closed before the stage runs.

breakdown.description: The ba-breakdown pack, hydrated. This is the AUTHORITATIVE shape of the work: elaboration adds detail to these stories and never re-groups the epics, invents a story, or restates a rule.

audit_id.description: The breakdown's provenance id; recorded in upstream_refs, never reused as this stage's audit_id.

state.description: Only ready-for-amigos may be elaborated. The engine gate enforces this; the skill re-checks it fail-closed.

blocks_elaboration.description: True when a governance gap blocks. Required, because the skill re-checks it fail-closed and a field that never arrives cannot be re-checked.

stories.description: Hydrated story SKELETONS: card, intent, rule_refs, flow_refs, entity_refs, priority, sizing, dependencies. No acceptance criteria - this stage writes them.

amigos_verdict.description: The recorded three-amigos gate decision, threaded in by the engine from the released quorum gate. Only `agreed` reaches this stage; the block is carried for provenance and to thread the conditions the reviewers attached to their signatures.

approvers.description: Named humans, one per required role (ba-lead, dev-lead, qa-lead).

conditions.description: The reviewers' own signature notes, in signing order. Binding: a condition is elaborated like a rule.
